Form factors (Kij) between all pairs of triangles based on visibility and geometry\n9\t * 2. Wave propagation using radiosity equations with time delays (Tau)\n10\t * 3. Distance estimation via cross-correlation of radiosity values\n11\t * \n12\t * The implementation generates a procedural icosphere mesh to simulate a room.\n13\t */\n14\t\n15\t#include val_t INV_WAVE_SPEED = 1.0f / WAVE_SPEED;\n43\tconstexpr int NUM_RAYS = 16;              // Number of rays for visibility sampling\n44\tconstexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;\n45\tconstexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;\n46\t\n47\t// ============================================================================\n48\t// Vector and Triangle Types\n49\t// ============================================================================\n50\t\n51\tstruct Vec3 {\n52\t    val_t x, y, z;\n53\t\n54\t    constexpr Vec3() : x(0), y(0), z(0) {}\n55\t    constexpr Vec3(val_t x, val_t y, val_t z) : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}\n56\t    explicit constexpr Vec3(val_t v) : x(v), y(v), z(v) {}\n57\t\n58\t    Vec3 operator+(const Vec3& o) const { return {x + o.x, y + o.y, z + o.z}; }\n59\t    Vec3 operator-(const Vec3& o) const { return {x - o.x, y - o.y, z - o.z}; }\n60\t    Vec3 operator*(val_t s) const { return {x * s, y * s, z * s}; }\n61\t    Vec3 operator/(val_t s) const { return {x / s, y / s, z / s}; }\n62\t    Vec3 operator-() const { return {-x, -y, -z}; }\n63\t\n64\t    val_t dot(const Vec3& o) const { return x * o.x + y * o.y + z * o.z; }\n65\t    Vec3 cross(const Vec3& o) const {\n66\t        return {y * o.z - z * o.y, z * o.x - x * o.z, x * o.y - y * o.x};\n67\t    }\n68\t\n69\t    val_t squaredNorm() const { return x * x + y * y + z * z; }\n70\t    val_t norm() const { return std::sqrt(squaredNorm()); }\n71\t    Vec3 normalized() const {\n72\t        val_t n = norm();\n73\t        return n > EPSILON ? *this / n : Vec3();\n74\t    }\n75\t\n76\t    bool operator==(const Vec3& o) const {\n77\t        return std::abs(x - o.x) < EPSILON && std::abs(y - o.y) < EPSILON && std::abs(z - o.z) < EPSILON;\n78\t    }\n79\t};\n80\t\n81\tstruct Triangle minMax3 = [](val_t a, val_t b, val_t c) {\n119\t        return std::make_pair(std::min({a, b, c}), std::max({a, b, c}));\n120\t    };\n121\t\n122\t    auto [minX, maxX] = minMax3(v0.x, v1.x, v2.x);\n123\t    if (minX > boxHalfSize.x || maxX < -boxHalfSize.x) return false;\n124\t\n125\t    auto [minY, maxY] = minMax3(v0.y, v1.y, v2.y);\n126\t    if (minY > boxHalfSize.y || maxY < -boxHalfSize.y) return false;\n127\t\n128\t    auto [minZ, maxZ] = minMax3(v0.z, v1.z, v2.z);\n129\t    if (minZ > boxHalfSize.z || maxZ < -boxHalfSize.z) return false;\n130\t\n131\t    // Test triangle normal\n132\t    Vec3 triNormal = e0.cross(e1);\n133\t    val_t d = triNormal.dot(v0);\n134\t    val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(triNormal.x) +\n135\t              boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(triNormal.y) +\n136\t              boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(triNormal.z);\n137\t    if (std::abs(d) > r) return false;\n138\t\n139\t    // Test 9 edge cross products\n140\t    auto testAxis = [&](const Vec3& axis) {\n141\t        val_t p0 = axis.dot(v0);\n142\t        val_t p1 = axis.dot(v1);\n143\t        val_t p2 = axis.dot(v2);\n144\t        val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(axis.x) +\n145\t                  boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(axis.y) +\n146\t                  boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(axis.z);\n147\t        auto [minP, maxP] = minMax3(p0, p1, p2);\n148\t        return !(minP > r || maxP < -r);\n149\t    };\n150\t\n151\t    Vec3 axes[3] = {{1,0,0}, {0,1,0}, {0,0,1}};\n152\t    Vec3 edges[3] = {e0, e1, e2};\n153\t    for (const auto& axis : axes) {\n154\t        for (const auto& edge : edges) {\n155\t            Vec3 crossAxis = axis.cross(edge);\n156\t            if (crossAxis.squaredNorm() > EPSILON) {\n157\t                if (!testAxis(crossAxis)) return false;\n158\t            }\n159\t        }\n160\t    }\n161\t\n162\t    return true;\n163\t}\n164\t\n165\t// ============================================================================\n166\t// Octree for Spatial Acceleration\n167\t// ============================================================================\n168\t\n169\tconstexpr size_t MAX_OCTREE_TRIS = 8;\n170\tconstexpr val_t MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE = 0.5f;\n171\t\n172\tclass Octree {\n173\tpublic:\n174\t    Vec3 minBound, maxBound;\n175\t    Vec3 halfExtent, center;\n176\t    std::unique_ptr<Octree> children[8];\n177\t    std::vector<size_t> triangleIndices;  // Indices into the global triangle list\n178\t    const std::vector<Triangle>* allTriangles;  // Pointer to all triangles\n179\t\n180\t    Octree() : allTriangles(nullptr) {}\n181\t\n182\t    void build(const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles) {\n183\t        allTriangles = &triangles;\n184\t        if (triangles.empty()) return;\n185\t\n186\t        // Compute bounding box\n187\t        minBound = triangles[0].a;\n188\t        maxBound = triangles[0].a;\n189\t        for (const auto& tri : triangles) {\n190\t            for (const auto* v : {&tri.a, &tri.b, &tri.c}) {\n191\t                minBound.x = std::min(minBound.x, v->x);\n192\t                minBound.y = std::min(minBound.y, v->y);\n193\t                minBound.z = std::min(minBound.z, v->z);\n194\t                maxBound.x = std::max(maxBound.x, v->x);\n195\t                maxBound.y = std::max(maxBound.y, v->y);\n196\t                maxBound.z = std::max(maxBound.z, v->z);\n197\t            }\n198\t        }\n199\t\n200\t        // Collect all indices\n201\t        std::vector<size_t> allIndices(triangles.size());\n202\t        for (size_t i = 0; i < triangles.size(); ++i) allIndices[i] = i;\n203\t\n204\t        buildNode(allIndices, minBound, maxBound);\n205\t    }\n206\t\n207\tprivate:\n208\t    void buildNode(const std::vector<size_t>& indices, const Vec3& nodeMin, const Vec3& nodeMax) {\n209\t        minBound = nodeMin;\n210\t        maxBound = nodeMax;\n211\t        halfExtent = (maxBound - minBound) * 0.5f;\n212\t        center = (minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;\n213\t\n214\t        // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf\n215\t        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n216\t            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n217\t            triangleIndices = indices;\n218\t            return;\n219\t        }\n220\t\n221\t        // Subdivide into 8 children\n222\t        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n223\t        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n224\t\n225\t        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n226\t            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];\n227\t\n228\t            // Check which children this triangle overlaps\n229\t            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n230\t                Vec3 childCenter = center;\n231\t                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;\n232\t                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;\n233\t                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n234\t\n235\t                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n236\t                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n237\t                }\n238\t            }\n239\t        }\n240\t\n241\t        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n242\t        bool canSplit = false;\n243\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n244\t            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n245\t                canSplit = true;\n246\t                break;\n247\t            }\n248\t        }\n249\t\n250\t        if (!canSplit) {\n251\t            triangleIndices = indices;\n252\t            return;\n253\t        }\n254\t\n255\t        // Build children\n256\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n257\t            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {\n258\t                Vec3 childMin = center;\n259\t                Vec3 childMax = center;\n260\t                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n261\t                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n262\t                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n263\t                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n264\t                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n265\t                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n266\t\n267\t                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n268\t                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n269\t                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n270\t            }\n271\t        }\n272\t    }\n273\t\n274\tpublic:\n275\t    // Check if a ray intersects this node's bounding box\n276\t    bool rayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) const {\n277\t        Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n278\t        Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n279\t        Vec3 ad = {std::abs(d.x), std::abs(d.y), std::abs(d.z)};\n280\t\n281\t        if (std::abs(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n282\t        if (std::abs(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n283\t        if (std::abs(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n284\t\n285\t        if (std::abs(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n286\t        if (std::abs(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n287\t        if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n288\t\n289\t        return true;\n290\t    }\n291\t\n292\t    // Apply a function to all triangles potentially intersecting the ray\n293\t    // Returns true if the function returns true for any triangle\n294\t    template<typename Func>\n295\t    bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {\n296\t        // If leaf node, check triangles directly\n297\t        if (!triangleIndices.empty()) {\n298\t            for (size_t idx : triangleIndices) {\n299\t                if (func(idx, (*allTriangles)[idx])) return true;\n300\t            }\n301\t            return false;\n302\t        }\n303\t\n304\t        // Otherwise, descend to children\n305\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n306\t            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) {\n307\t                if (children[i]->applyToTris(p1, p2, func)) return true;\n308\t            }\n309\t        }\n310\t        return false;\n311\t    }\n312\t};\n313\t\n314\t// ============================================================================\n315\t// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n316\t// ============================================================================\n317\t\n318\t// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\n319\tclass IcosphereMesh {\n320\tpublic:\n321\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n322\t\n323\t    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n324\t        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n325\t        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n326\t\n327\t        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n328\t            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n329\t            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n330\t            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n331\t            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n332\t            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n333\t            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n334\t            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n335\t            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n336\t            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n337\t            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n338\t            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n339\t            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n340\t        };\n341\t\n342\t        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n343\t        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n344\t            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n345\t            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n346\t            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n347\t            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n348\t        };\n349\t\n350\t        // Subdivide\n351\t        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n352\t            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n353\t            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n354\t\n355\t            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n356\t                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n357\t                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n358\t                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n359\t\n360\t                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n361\t                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n362\t                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n363\t                vertices.push_back(mid);\n364\t                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n365\t                return idx;\n366\t            };\n367\t\n368\t            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n369\t                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n370\t                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n371\t                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n372\t\n373\t                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n374\t                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n375\t                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n376\t                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n377\t            }\n378\t            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n379\t        }\n380\t\n381\t        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n382\t        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n383\t        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n384\t            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n385\t            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n386\t        }\n387\t    }\n388\t};\n389\t\n390\t// ============================================================================\n391\t// Random Number Generation\n392\t// ============================================================================\n393\t\n394\tclass RandomGenerator {\n395\t    std::mt19937 rng;\n396\t    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\n397\tpublic:\n398\t    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n399\t    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n400\t};\n401\t\n402\t// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\n403\tVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n404\t    val_t u = rng.rand();\n405\t    val_t v = rng.rand();\n406\t    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n407\t        u = 1.0f - u;\n408\t        v = 1.0f - v;\n409\t    }\n410\t    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n411\t    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n412\t    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n413\t}\n414\t\n415\t// ============================================================================\n416\t// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n417\t// ============================================================================\n418\t\n419\tval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n420\t                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n421\t    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n422\t    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n423\t    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n424\t    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n425\t\n426\t    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n427\t\n428\t    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n429\t    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n430\t    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n431\t    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n432\t\n433\t    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n434\t    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n435\t    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n436\t\n437\t    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n438\t}\n439\t\n440\t// ============================================================================\n441\t// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n442\t// ============================================================================\n443\t\n444\t// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n445\t// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\n446\tbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n447\t                  const Octree& octree,\n448\t                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n449\t    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n450\t    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n451\t    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n452\t    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n453\t\n454\t    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n455\t        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n456\t\n457\t        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n458\t        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n459\t            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n460\t        }\n461\t        return false;\n462\t    });\n463\t}\n464\t\n465\t// ============================================================================\n466\t// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n467\t// ============================================================================\n468\t\n469\t// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n470\tval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n471\t    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n472\t    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n473\t    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n474\t}\n475\t\n476\t// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\n477\tval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n478\t                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n479\t                  const Octree& octree,\n480\t                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n481\t    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n482\t    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n483\t\n484\t    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n485\t    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n486\t\n487\t    val_t kij = ZERO;\n488\t\n489\t    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n490\t        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n491\t        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n492\t\n493\t        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n494\t\n495\t        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n496\t        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n497\t        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n498\t\n499\t        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n500\t        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n501\t\n502\t        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n503\t\n504\t        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n505\t    }\n506\t\n507\t    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n508\t}\n509\t\n510\t// ============================================================================\n511\t// Tau (time delay) Computation\n512\t// ============================================================================\n513\t\n514\tint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n515\t    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n516\t    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n517\t}\n518\t\n519\t// ============================================================================\n520\t// Room Response Simulation State\n521\t// ============================================================================\n522\t\n523\tstruct SimulationState {\n524\t    size_t numTriangles;\n525\t    size_t numTimesteps;\n526\t\n527\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n528\t    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n529\t    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n530\t    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n531\t    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n532\t    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n533\t    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n534\t    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n535\t\n536\t    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n537\t\n538\t    size_t sourceIndex;\n539\t\n540\t    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n541\t    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n542\t};\n543\t\n544\t// ============================================================================\n545\t// Initialization\n546\t// ============================================================================\n547\t\n548\tvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n549\t                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n550\t    // Generate mesh\n551\t    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n552\t    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n553\t    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n554\t    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n555\t    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n556\t\n557\t    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n558\t\n559\t    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n560\t    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n561\t    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n562\t\n563\t    // Initialize areas\n564\t    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n565\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n566\t        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n567\t    }\n568\t\n569\t    // Initialize reflectivity\n570\t    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n571\t\n572\t    // Initialize matrices\n573\t    state.kij.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n574\t    state.tau.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, 0);\n575\t    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n576\t    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n577\t    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n578\t\n579\t    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n580\t    size_t timeOn = 0;\n581\t    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n582\t    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n583\t        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n584\t    }\n585\t}\n586\t\n587\t// ============================================================================\n588\t// Precomputation Phase\n589\t// ============================================================================\n590\t\n591\tvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n592\t    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n593\t    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n594\t\n595\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n596\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n597\t            if (i == j) continue;\n598\t            state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeKij(\n599\t                i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);\n600\t        }\n601\t        if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == state.numTriangles) {\n602\t            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, state.numTriangles);\n603\t        }\n604\t    }\n605\t}\n606\t\n607\tvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n608\t    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n609\t\n610\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n611\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n612\t            if (i == j) continue;\n613\t            state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeTau(\n614\t                state.triangles[i], u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// One thread per (receiver i, emitter j) pair. The pair's draws are the\n// RANDS_PER_PAIR values starting at draws[k * RANDS_PER_PAIR], where k is the\n// pair's position in the chunk, which matches the sequential RNG consumption order.\n// kijT is stored transposed: kijT[j * N + i] = Kij.\n__global__ void formFactorKernel(const uint2* __restrict__ pairs, const val_t* __restrict__ draws,\n                                 size_t numPairs, DeviceGeometry geo, val_t* kijT, size_t N) {\n    size_t k = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x;\n    if (k >= numPairs) return;\n\n    const uint2 pr = pairs[k];\n    const size_t i = pr.x;\n    const size_t j = pr.y;\n    const DevTriangle& triI = geo.tris[i];\n    const DevTriangle& triJ = geo.tris[j];\n    const val_t* rnd = draws + k * RANDS_PER_PAIR;\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = samplePoint(triI, rnd);\n        Vec3 pJ = samplePoint(triJ, rnd + 2);\n        rnd += 4;\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, geo, i, j)) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.n);\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.n);\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    kijT[j * N + i] = kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation (device)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// One thread per matrix entry. tauT is stored transposed: tauT[j * N + i] = Tau_ij\n__global__ void timeDelayKernel(const Vec3* __restrict__ centers, int* tauT, size_t N) {\n    size_t idx = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x;\n    if (idx >= N * N) return;\n\n    size_t j = idx / N;\n    size_t i = idx - j * N;\n    if (i == j) {\n        tauT[idx] = 0;\n        return;\n    }\n\n    val_t dist = (centers[i] - centers[j]).norm();\n    tauT[idx] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;  // Host geometry (normals are used for culling)\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;         // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;           // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;          // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix), host copy used for init\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;          // Reflected radiosity (T x N), copied back for validation\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;     // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                    // Host-side spatial structure (flattened to dNodes)\n\n    // Device-side data\n    DevTriangle* dTriangles = nullptr;\n    DevNode* dNodes = nullptr;\n    uint32_t* dLeafTris = nullptr;\n    Vec3* dCenters = nullptr;\n    val_t* dAreas = nullptr;\n    val_t* dRho = nullptr;\n    val_t* dRadE = nullptr;\n    val_t* dRadB = nullptr;           // T x N\n    val_t* dKijT = nullptr;           // N x N, transposed: [j * N + i]\n    int* dTauT = nullptr;             // N x N, transposed: [j * N + i]\n    val_t* dDistances = nullptr;\n\n    DeviceGeometry geometry() const { return {dTriangles, dNodes, dLeafTris}; }\n};\n\ntemplate <typename T>\nT* deviceUpload(const std::vector<T>& host) {\n    T* dev = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev, host.size() * sizeof(T)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dev, host.data(), host.size() * sizeof(T), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    return dev;\n}\n\ntemplate <typename T>\nT* deviceZeros(size_t count) {\n    T* dev = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev, count * sizeof(T)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dev, 0, count * sizeof(T)));\n    return dev;\n}\n\ninline unsigned int blocksFor(size_t n) {\n    return static_cast<unsigned int>((n + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / BLOCK_SIZE);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t T = timesteps;\n\n    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", N);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n    FlatOctree flat = flattenOctree(state.octree);\n    if (flat.maxDepth * 8 + 8 > TRAVERSAL_STACK) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"Octree too deep for device traversal stack (depth %d)\\n\", flat.maxDepth);\n        exit(1);\n    }\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(N);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.assign(N, reflectivity);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    state.radE.assign(T * N, ZERO);\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[t * N + state.sourceIndex] = 1.0f;\n    }\n\n    // Upload geometry and data to the device\n    std::vector<DevTriangle> devTris(N);\n    std::vector<Vec3> centers(N);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        const Triangle& tri = state.triangles[i];\n        devTris[i] = {tri.a, tri.b, tri.c, tri.normal()};\n        centers[i] = tri.center();\n    }\n\n    state.dTriangles = deviceUpload(devTris);\n    state.dNodes = deviceUpload(flat.nodes);\n    state.dLeafTris = deviceUpload(flat.leafTris);\n    state.dCenters = deviceUpload(centers);\n    state.dAreas = deviceUpload(state.areas);\n    state.dRho = deviceUpload(state.rho);\n    state.dRadE = deviceUpload(state.radE);\n    state.dRadB = deviceZeros<val_t>(T * N);\n    state.dKijT = deviceZeros<val_t>(N * N);\n    state.dTauT = deviceZeros<int>(N * N);\n    state.dDistances = deviceZeros<val_t>(N);\n}\n\nvoid releaseDevice(SimulationState& state) {\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.dTriangles));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.dNodes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.dLeafTris));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.dCenters));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.dAreas));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.dRho));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.dRadE));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.dRadB));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.dKijT));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.dTauT));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.dDistances));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\nstatic void reportProgress(size_t from, size_t to, size_t total) {\n    for (size_t done = from + 1; done <= to; ++done) {\n        if (done % 100 == 0 || done == total) {\n            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", done, total);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const DeviceGeometry geo = state.geometry();\n\n    // The sequential reference draws from one RNG stream, in (i, j) order, and only\n    // for pairs that are not culled. The host reproduces exactly that stream in chunks\n    // of whole receiver rows; the device evaluates each chunk. Two buffers let the host\n    // generate chunk c+1 while the device works on chunk c.\n    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n\n    constexpr int NUM_BUFFERS = 2;\n    const size_t capacity = std::max(static_cast<size_t>(1) << 18, N);  // Pairs per chunk\n\n    cudaStream_t stream;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreate(&stream));\n\n    uint2* hPairs[NUM_BUFFERS];\n    val_t* hDraws[NUM_BUFFERS];\n    uint2* dPairs[NUM_BUFFERS];\n    val_t* dDraws[NUM_BUFFERS];\n    cudaEvent_t done[NUM_BUFFERS];\n    size_t chunkEnd[NUM_BUFFERS] = {0, 0};\n    bool busy[NUM_BUFFERS] = {false, false};\n\n    for (int b = 0; b < NUM_BUFFERS; ++b) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hPairs[b], capacity * sizeof(uint2)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hDraws[b], capacity * RANDS_PER_PAIR * sizeof(val_t)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dPairs[b], capacity * sizeof(uint2)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dDraws[b], capacity * RANDS_PER_PAIR * sizeof(val_t)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&done[b], cudaEventDisableTiming));\n    }\n\n    size_t reported = 0;\n    size_t rowBegin = 0;\n    int b = 0;\n    while (rowBegin < N) {\n        // Wait until this buffer's previous chunk has been uploaded and evaluated\n        if (busy[b]) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(done[b]));\n            reportProgress(reported, chunkEnd[b], N);\n            reported = chunkEnd[b];\n        }\n\n        // Generate draws for whole rows, in the sequential order\n        size_t rowEnd = rowBegin;\n        size_t numPairs = 0;\n        while (rowEnd < N && numPairs + N - 1 <= capacity) {\n            const Vec3 nI = state.triangles[rowEnd].normal();\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n                if (j == rowEnd) continue;\n                // Cull triangles facing the same direction (no draws consumed)\n                if (nI.dot(state.triangles[j].normal()) > 0.99f) continue;\n\n                hPairs[b][numPairs] = make_uint2(static_cast<unsigned int>(rowEnd),\n                                                 static_cast<unsigned int>(j));\n                val_t* out = hDraws[b] + numPairs * RANDS_PER_PAIR;\n                for (int r = 0; r < RANDS_PER_PAIR; ++r) {\n                    out[r] = rng.rand();\n                }\n                ++numPairs;\n            }\n            ++rowEnd;\n        }\n\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dPairs[b], hPairs[b], numPairs * sizeof(uint2),\n                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dDraws[b], hDraws[b], numPairs * RANDS_PER_PAIR * sizeof(val_t),\n                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));\n        if (numPairs > 0) {\n            formFactorKernel<<<blocksFor(numPairs), BLOCK_SIZE, 0, stream>>>(\n                dPairs[b], dDraws[b], numPairs, geo, state.dKijT, N);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(done[b], stream));\n\n        busy[b] = true;\n        chunkEnd[b] = rowEnd;\n        rowBegin = rowEnd;\n        b ^= 1;\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));\n    reportProgress(reported, N, N);\n\n    for (int k = 0; k < NUM_BUFFERS; ++k) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hPairs[k]));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hDraws[k]));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dPairs[k]));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dDraws[k]));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(done[k]));\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(stream));\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    timeDelayKernel<<<blocksFor(N * N), BLOCK_SIZE>>>(state.dCenters, state.dTauT, N);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Computes radB[t][i] for all receivers i. Tau_ij >= 1 for i != j, so every read\n// is from an earlier timestep and receivers within a timestep are independent.\n// The sum over j keeps the sequential order, so results match the reference exactly.\n__global__ void waveStepKernel(size_t t, size_t N, const val_t* __restrict__ kijT,\n                               const int* __restrict__ tauT, const val_t* __restrict__ areas,\n                               const val_t* __restrict__ rho, const val_t* __restrict__ radE,\n                               val_t* radB) {\n    size_t i = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= N) return;\n\n    val_t sumB = ZERO;\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n        if (i == j) continue;\n\n        int tauij = tauT[j * N + i];\n\n        // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n        if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n\n        val_t kij = kijT[j * N + i];\n        if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n        size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n        val_t radJ = radB[srcTime * N + j];\n        if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n        sumB += vmin(kij * areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n    }\n\n    // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n    radB[t * N + i] = rho[i] * sumB + radE[t * N + i];\n}\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n        waveStepKernel<<<blocksFor(N), BLOCK_SIZE>>>(t, N, state.dKijT, state.dTauT, state.dAreas,\n                                                      state.dRho, state.dRadE, state.dRadB);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == T) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, T);\n        }\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// One thread per triangle. Each thread runs the same sequential correlation loop as\n// the reference, so the argmax (first maximum wins) is identical.\n__global__ void distanceKernel(size_t N, size_t T, size_t sourceIndex, const val_t* __restrict__ radB,\n                               val_t* distances) {\n    size_t i = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= N) return;\n\n    val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n    int bestT = 0;\n\n    // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n        val_t sum = ZERO;\n\n        for (size_t tt = t; tt < T; ++tt) {\n            val_t pB = radB[tt * N + i];\n            val_t pS = radB[(tt - t) * N + sourceIndex];\n            sum += pS * pB;\n        }\n\n        if (sum > maxCorr) {\n            maxCorr = sum;\n            bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n        }\n    }\n\n    distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n}\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    distanceKernel<<<blocksFor(N), BLOCK_SIZE>>>(N, state.numTimesteps, state.sourceIndex,\n                                                  state.dRadB, state.dDistances);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n    state.distances.resize(N);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.distances.data(), state.dDistances, N * sizeof(val_t),\n                          cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Validation\n// ============================================================================\n\nbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state, const std::vector<val_t>& kij) {\n    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n        if (d < 0) {\n            allNonNegative = false;\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n        }\n        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n            return false;\n        }\n        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n        sumDist += d;\n        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n    printf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n    }\n\n    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            if (state.radB[t * state.numTriangles + i] > EPSILON) {\n                receivedEnergy++;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n\n    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n    int nonZeroKij = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        if (kij[i] > EPSILON) nonZeroKij++;\n    }\n    printf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %d/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n           nonZeroKij, state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles,\n           100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles));\n\n    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (!allNonNegative) {\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Hash for Verification\n// ============================================================================\n\nuint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        const uint32_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(&state.distances[i]);\n        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(*ptr) + i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;\n    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Helper: Compute subdivision level from target triangle count\n// ============================================================================\n\nint getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(int targetTriangles) {\n    // Icosphere: 20 triangles initially, 4x per subdivision\n    // subdivisions: 0->20, 1->80, 2->320, 3->1280, 4->5120, 5->20480\n    int subdivisions = 0;\n    int triangles = 20;\n    while (triangles < targetTriangles && subdivisions < 6) {\n        subdivisions++;\n        triangles *= 4;\n    }\n    return subdivisions;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Main\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Target number of triangles (default: 320)\\n\");\n    printf(\"               Actual count will be rounded to nearest icosphere level:\\n\");\n    printf(\"               20, 80, 320, 1280, 5120, 20480\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <num>     Number of timesteps (default: 50)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Source triangle index (default: 0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r <val>     Reflectivity 0.0-1.0 (default: 0.8)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -o           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int targetTriangles = 320;\n    int timesteps = 50;\n    int sourceIdx = 0;\n    val_t reflectivity = 0.8f;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            targetTriangles = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            timesteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sourceIdx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            reflectivity = static_cast<val_t>(atof(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-o\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    int subdivisions = getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(targetTriangles);\n\n    printf(\"Room Response Simulation Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"===================================\\n\");\n    printf(\"Target triangles: %d (using %d subdivisions)\\n\", targetTriangles, subdivisions);\n    printf(\"Timesteps: %d\\n\", timesteps);\n    printf(\"Source triangle: %d\\n\", sourceIdx);\n    printf(\"Reflectivity: %.2f\\n\", reflectivity);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    printf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Initialize\n    SimulationState state;\n    initializeSimulation(state, subdivisions, static_cast<size_t>(timesteps),\n                         static_cast<size_t>(sourceIdx), reflectivity);\n\n    printf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Precomputation\n    auto startPre = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    computeTimeDelays(state);\n    computeFormFactors(state);\n\n    auto endPre = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto preDuration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(endPre - startPre).count();\n\n    printf(\"Precomputation time: %ld ms\\n\", preDuration);\n    printf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Simulation\n    auto startSim = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    runSimulation(state);\n\n    auto endSim = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto simDuration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(endSim - startSim).count();\n\n    printf(\"Simulation time: %ld ms\\n\", simDuration);\n    printf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Distance computation\n    auto startDist = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    computeDistances(state);\n\n    auto endDist = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto distDuration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(endDist - startDist).count();\n\n    printf(\"Distance computation time: %ld EPSILON) {\n                    return true;  // Ray is blocked\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c) {\n                int ch = node.child[c];\n                if (ch >= 0 && boxRayHit(geo.nodes[ch].center, geo.nodes[ch].halfExtent, from, to)) {\n                    stack[sp++] = ch;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij, device)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\nHD inline val_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return vmax(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// Random point in a triangle from two uniform draws (same arithmetic as the sequential code)\n__device__ inline Vec3 samplePoint(const DevTriangle& t, const val_t* uv) {\n    val_t u = uv[0];\n    val_t v = uv[1];\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// One thread per (receiver i, emitter j) pair. The pair's draws are the\n// RANDS_PER_PAIR values starting at draws[k * RANDS_PER_PAIR], where k is the\n// pair's position in the chunk, which matches the sequential RNG consumption order.\n// kijT is stored transposed: kijT[j * N + i] = Kij.\n__global__ void formFactorKernel(const uint2* __restrict__ pairs, const val_t* __restrict__ draws,\n                                 size_t numPairs, DeviceGeometry geo, val_t* kijT, size_t N) {\n    size_t k = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x;\n    if (k >= numPairs) return;\n\n    const uint2 pr = pairs[k];\n    const size_t i = pr.x;\n    const size_t j = pr.y;\n    const DevTriangle& triI = geo.tris[i];\n    const DevTriangle& triJ = geo.tris[j];\n    const val_t* rnd = draws + k * RANDS_PER_PAIR;\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = samplePoint(triI, rnd);\n        Vec3 pJ = samplePoint(triJ, rnd + 2);\n        rnd += 4;\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, geo, i, j)) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.n);\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.n);\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    kijT[j * N + i] = kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation (device)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// One thread per matrix entry. tauT is stored transposed: tauT[j * N + i] = Tau_ij\n__global__ void timeDelayKernel(const Vec3* __restrict__ centers, int* tauT, size_t N) {\n    size_t idx = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x;\n    if (idx >= N * N) return;\n\n    size_t j = idx / N;\n    size_t i = idx - j * N;\n    if (i == j) {\n        tauT[idx] = 0;\n        return;\n    }\n\n    val_t dist = (centers[i] - centers[j]).norm();\n    tauT[idx] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;  // Host geometry (normals are used for culling)\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;         // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;           // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;          // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix), host copy used for init\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;          // Reflected radiosity (T x N), copied back for validation\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;     // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                    // Host-side spatial structure (flattened to dNodes)\n\n    // Device-side data\n    DevTriangle* dTriangles = nullptr;\n    DevNode* dNodes = nullptr;\n    uint32_t* dLeafTris = nullptr;\n    Vec3* dCenters = nullptr;\n    val_t* dAreas = nullptr;\n    val_t* dRho = nullptr;\n    val_t* dRadE = nullptr;\n    val_t* dRadB = nullptr;           // T x N\n    val_t* dKijT = nullptr;           // N x N, transposed: [j * N + i]\n    int* dTauT = nullptr;             // N x N, transposed: [j * N + i]\n    val_t* dDistances = nullptr;\n\n    DeviceGeometry geometry() const { return {dTriangles, dNodes, dLeafTris}; }\n};\n\ntemplate <typename T>\nT* deviceUpload(const std::vector<T>& host) {\n    T* dev = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev, host.size() * sizeof(T)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dev, host.data(), host.size() * sizeof(T), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    return dev;\n}\n\ntemplate <typename T>\nT* deviceZeros(size_t count) {\n    T* dev = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev, count * sizeof(T)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dev, 0, count * sizeof(T)));\n    return dev;\n}\n\ninline unsigned int blocksFor(size_t n) {\n    return static_cast<unsigned int>((n + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / BLOCK_SIZE);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t T = timesteps;\n\n    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", N);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n    FlatOctree flat = flattenOctree(state.octree);\n    if (flat.maxDepth * 8 + 8 > TRAVERSAL_STACK) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"Octree too deep for device traversal stack (depth %d)\\n\", flat.maxDepth);\n        exit(1);\n    }\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(N);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.assign(N, reflectivity);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    state.radE.assign(T * N, ZERO);\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[t * N + state.sourceIndex] = 1.0f;\n    }\n\n    // Upload geometry and data to the device\n    std::vector<DevTriangle> devTris(N);\n    std::vector<Vec3> centers(N);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        const Triangle& tri = state.triangles[i];\n        devTris[i] = {tri.a, tri.b, tri.c, tri.normal()};\n        centers[i] = tri.center();\n    }\n\n    state.dTriangles = deviceUpload(devTris);\n    state.dNodes = deviceUpload(flat.nodes);\n    state.dLeafTris = deviceUpload(flat.leafTris);\n    state.dCenters = deviceUpload(centers);\n    state.dAreas = deviceUpload(state.areas);\n    state.dRho = deviceUpload(state.rho);\n    state.dRadE = deviceUpload(state.radE);\n    state.dRadB = deviceZeros<val_t>(T * N);\n    state.dKijT = deviceZeros<val_t>(N * N);\n    state.dTauT = deviceZeros<int>(N * N);\n    state.dDistances = deviceZeros<val_t>(N);\n}\n\nvoid releaseDevice(SimulationState& state) {\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.dTriangles));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.dNodes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.dLeafTris));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.dCenters));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.dAreas));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.dRho));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.dRadE));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.dRadB));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.dKijT));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.dTauT));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(state.dDistances));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\nstatic void reportProgress(size_t from, size_t to, size_t total) {\n    for (size_t done = from + 1; done <= to; ++done) {\n        if (done % 100 == 0 || done == total) {\n            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", done, total);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const DeviceGeometry geo = state.geometry();\n\n    // The sequential reference draws from one RNG stream, in (i, j) order, and only\n    // for pairs that are not culled. The host reproduces exactly that stream in chunks\n    // of whole receiver rows; the device evaluates each chunk. Two buffers let the host\n    // generate chunk c+1 while the device works on chunk c.\n    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n\n    constexpr int NUM_BUFFERS = 2;\n    const size_t capacity = std::max(static_cast<size_t>(1) << 18, N);  // Pairs per chunk\n\n    cudaStream_t stream;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreate(&stream));\n\n    uint2* hPairs[NUM_BUFFERS];\n    val_t* hDraws[NUM_BUFFERS];\n    uint2* dPairs[NUM_BUFFERS];\n    val_t* dDraws[NUM_BUFFERS];\n    cudaEvent_t done[NUM_BUFFERS];\n    size_t chunkEnd[NUM_BUFFERS] = {0, 0};\n    bool busy[NUM_BUFFERS] = {false, false};\n\n    for (int b = 0; b < NUM_BUFFERS; ++b) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hPairs[b], capacity * sizeof(uint2)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hDraws[b], capacity * RANDS_PER_PAIR * sizeof(val_t)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dPairs[b], capacity * sizeof(uint2)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dDraws[b], capacity * RANDS_PER_PAIR * sizeof(val_t)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&done[b], cudaEventDisableTiming));\n    }\n\n    size_t reported = 0;\n    size_t rowBegin = 0;\n    int b = 0;\n    while (rowBegin < N) {\n        // Wait until this buffer's previous chunk has been uploaded and evaluated\n        if (busy[b]) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(done[b]));\n            reportProgress(reported, chunkEnd[b], N);\n            reported = chunkEnd[b];\n        }\n\n        // Generate draws for whole rows, in the sequential order\n        size_t rowEnd = rowBegin;\n        size_t numPairs = 0;\n        while (rowEnd < N && numPairs + N - 1 <= capacity) {\n            const Vec3 nI = state.triangles[rowEnd].normal();\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n                if (j == rowEnd) continue;\n                // Cull triangles facing the same direction (no draws consumed)\n                if (nI.dot(state.triangles[j].normal()) > 0.99f) continue;\n\n                hPairs[b][numPairs] = make_uint2(static_cast<unsigned int>(rowEnd),\n                                                 static_cast<unsigned int>(j));\n                val_t* out = hDraws[b] + numPairs * RANDS_PER_PAIR;\n                for (int r = 0; r < RANDS_PER_PAIR; ++r) {\n                    out[r] = rng.rand();\n                }\n                ++numPairs;\n            }\n            ++rowEnd;\n        }\n\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dPairs[b], hPairs[b], numPairs * sizeof(uint2),\n                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dDraws[b], hDraws[b], numPairs * RANDS_PER_PAIR * sizeof(val_t),\n                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));\n        if (numPairs > 0) {\n            formFactorKernel<<<blocksFor(numPairs), BLOCK_SIZE, 0, stream>>>(\n                dPairs[b], dDraws[b], numPairs, geo, state.dKijT, N);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(done[b], stream));\n\n        busy[b] = true;\n        chunkEnd[b] = rowEnd;\n        rowBegin = rowEnd;\n        b ^= 1;\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));\n    reportProgress(reported, N, N);\n\n    for (int k = 0; k < NUM_BUFFERS; ++k) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hPairs[k]));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hDraws[k]));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dPairs[k]));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dDraws[k]));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(done[k]));\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(stream));\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    timeDelayKernel<<<blocksFor(N * N), BLOCK_SIZE>>>(state.dCenters, state.dTauT, N);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Computes radB[t][i] for all receivers i. Tau_ij >= 1 for i != j, so every read\n// is from an earlier timestep and receivers within a timestep are independent.\n// The sum over j keeps the sequential order, so results match the reference exactly.\n__global__ void waveStepKernel(size_t t, size_t N, const val_t* __restrict__ kijT,\n                               const int* __restrict__ tauT, const val_t* __restrict__ areas,\n                               const val_t* __restrict__ rho, const val_t* __restrict__ radE,\n                               val_t* radB) {\n    size_t i = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= N) return;\n\n    val_t sumB = ZERO;\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n        if (i == j) continue;\n\n        int tauij = tauT[j * N + i];\n\n        // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n        if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n\n        val_t kij = kijT[j * N + i];\n        if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n        size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n        val_t radJ = radB[srcTime * N + j];\n        if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n        sumB += vmin(kij * areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n    }\n\n    // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n    radB[t * N + i] = rho[i] * sumB + radE[t * N + i];\n}\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n        waveStepKernel<<<blocksFor(N), BLOCK_SIZE>>>(t, N, state.dKijT, state.dTauT, state.dAreas,\n                                                      state.dRho, state.dRadE, state.dRadB);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == T) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, T);\n        }\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// One thread per triangle. Each thread runs the same sequential correlation loop as\n// the reference, so the argmax (first maximum wins) is identical.\n__global__ void distanceKernel(size_t N, size_t T, size_t sourceIndex, const val_t* __restrict__ radB,\n                               val_t* distances) {\n    size_t i = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= N) return;\n\n    val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n    int bestT = 0;\n\n    // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n        val_t sum = ZERO;\n\n        for (size_t tt = t; tt < T; ++tt) {\n            val_t pB = radB[tt * N + i];\n            val_t pS = radB[(tt - t) * N + sourceIndex];\n            sum += pS * pB;\n        }\n\n        if (sum > maxCorr) {\n            maxCorr = sum;\n            bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n        }\n    }\n\n    distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n}\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    distanceKernel<<<blocksFor(N), BLOCK_SIZE>>>(N, state.numTimesteps, state.sourceIndex,\n                                                  state.dRadB, state.dDistances);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n    state.distances.resize(N);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.distances.data(), state.dDistances, N * sizeof(val_t),\n                          cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Validation\n// ============================================================================\n\nbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state, const std::vector<val_t>& kij) {\n    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n        if (d < 0) {\n            allNonNegative = false;\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n        }\n        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n            return false;\n        }\n        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n        sumDist += d;\n        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n    printf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n    }\n\n    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            if (state.radB[t * state.numTriangles + i] > EPSILON) {\n                receivedEnergy++;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n\n    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n    int nonZeroKij = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        if (kij[i] > EPSILON) nonZeroKij++;\n    }\n    printf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %d/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n           nonZeroKij, state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles,\n           100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles));\n\n    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (!allNonNegative) {\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Hash for Verification\n// ============================================================================\n\nuint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        const uint32_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(&state.distances[i]);\n        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(*ptr) + i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;\n    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Helper: Compute subdivision level from target triangle count\n// ============================================================================\n\nint getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(int targetTriangles) {\n    // Icosphere: 20 triangles initially, 4x per subdivision\n    // subdivisions: 0->20, 1->80, 2->320, 3->1280, 4->5120, 5->20480\n    int subdivisions = 0;\n    int triangles = 20;\n    while (triangles < targetTriangles && subdivisions < 6) {\n        subdivisions++;\n        triangles *= 4;\n    }\n    return subdivisions;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Main\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Target number of triangles (default: 320)\\n\");\n    printf(\"               Actual count will be rounded to nearest icosphere level:\\n\");\n    printf(\"               20, 80, 320, 1280, 5120, 20480\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <num>     Number of timesteps (default: 50)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Source triangle index (default: 0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r <val>     Reflectivity 0.0-1.0 (default: 0.8)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -o           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int targetTriangles = 320;\n    int timesteps = 50;\n    int sourceIdx = 0;\n    val_t reflectivity = 0.8f;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            targetTriangles = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            timesteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sourceIdx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            reflectivity = static_cast<val_t>(atof(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-o\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    int subdivisions = getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(targetTriangles);\n\n    printf(\"Room Response Simulation Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"===================================\\n\");\n    printf(\"Target triangles: %d (using %d subdivisions)\\n\", targetTriangles, subdivisions);\n    printf(\"Timesteps: %d\\n\", timesteps);\n    printf(\"Source triangle: %d\\n\", sourceIdx);\n    printf(\"Reflectivity: %.2f\\n\", reflectivity);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    printf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Initialize\n    SimulationState state;\n    initializeSimulation(state, subdivisions, static_cast<size_t>(timesteps),\n                         static_cast<size_t>(sourceIdx), reflectivity);\n\n    printf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Precomputation\n    auto startPre = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    computeTimeDelays(state);\n It models how sound/light\n * waves propagate between surfaces in a room by computing:\n * \n * 1. Form factors (Kij) between all pairs of triangles based on visibility and geometry\n * 2. Wave propagation using radiosity equations with time delays (Tau)\n * 3. Distance estimation via cross-correlation of radiosity values\n * \n * The implementation generates a procedural icosphere mesh to simulate a room.\n */\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <array>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdint>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <map>\n#include <memory>\n#include <random>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Types and Constants\n// ============================================================================\n\nusing idx_t = uint32_t;\nusing val_t = float;\n\nconstexpr val_t PI = 3.14159265358979323846f;\nconstexpr val_t ZERO = 0.0f;\nconstexpr val_t ONE = 1.0f;\nconstexpr val_t WAVE_SPEED = 0.5f;        // Wave propagation speed (units per timestep)\nconstexpr val_t INV_WAVE_SPEED = 1.0f / WAVE_SPEED;\nconstexpr int NUM_RAYS = 16;              // Number of rays for visibility sampling\nconstexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;\nconstexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Vector and Triangle Types\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct Vec3 {\n    val_t x, y, z;\n\n    constexpr Vec3() : x(0), y(0), z(0) {}\n    constexpr Vec3(val_t x, val_t y, val_t z) : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}\n    explicit constexpr Vec3(val_t v) : x(v), y(v), z(v) {}\n\n    Vec3 operator+(const Vec3& o) const { return {x + o.x, y + o.y, z + o.z}; }\n    Vec3 operator-(const Vec3& o) const { return {x - o.x, y - o.y, z - o.z}; }\n    Vec3 operator*(val_t s) const { return {x * s, y * s, z * s}; }\n    Vec3 operator/(val_t s) const { return {x / s, y / s, z / s}; }\n    Vec3 operator-() const { return {-x, -y, -z}; }\n\n    val_t dot(const Vec3& o) const { return x * o.x + y * o.y + z * o.z; }\n    Vec3 cross(const Vec3& o) const {\n        return {y * o.z - z * o.y, z * o.x - x * o.z, x * o.y - y * o.x};\n    }\n\n    val_t squaredNorm() const { return x * x + y * y + z * z; }\n    val_t norm() const { return std::sqrt(squaredNorm()); }\n    Vec3 normalized() const {\n        val_t n = norm();\n        return n > EPSILON ? *this / n : Vec3();\n    }\n\n    bool operator==(const Vec3& o) const {\n        return std::abs(x - o.x) < EPSILON && std::abs(y - o.y) < EPSILON && std::abs(z - o.z) < EPSILON;\n    }\n};\n\nstruct Triangle {\n    Vec3 a, b, c;\n    Vec3 _normal;\n\n    Triangle() = default;\n    Triangle(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b, const Vec3& c)\n        : a(a), b(b), c(c), _normal((b - a).cross(c - a).normalized()) {}\n\n    Vec3 center() const { return (a + b + c) / 3.0f; }\n    Vec3 normal() const { return _normal; }\n\n    val_t area() const {\n        Vec3 ab = b - a;\n        Vec3 ac = c - a;\n        return 0.5f * ab.cross(ac).norm();\n    }\n\n    bool operator==(const Triangle& o) const { return a == o.a && b == o.b && c == o.c; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Triangle-Box Overlap Test (for octree construction)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Separating axis test for triangle-box overlap\nbool triangleBoxOverlap(const Vec3& boxCenter, const Vec3& boxHalfSize, const Triangle& tri) {\n    // Translate triangle to box center\n    Vec3 v0 = tri.a - boxCenter;\n    Vec3 v1 = tri.b - boxCenter;\n    Vec3 v2 = tri.c - boxCenter;\n\n    // Triangle Its output matches the original sequential build exactly. The bottleneck is now the host-side random number stream, which dominates runtime at large sizes.\n\n**Verification**\n- Default run: result hash `73869AC4B37EDF00` and the printed hash are identical to the original.\n- `-n 1280 -t 50 -v -o`: every line matches the original except timings and progress lines, including the full RESULTS block and validation.\n- Five other parameter sets (`-t 37 -s 5 -r 0.9`, `-t 0`, `-t 1`, `-n 20`, `-s 1000`) also match, including exit codes.\n- Timing: 1280 triangles went from 26.5 s to 0.6 s. 5120 triangles takes 6.2 s, and 20480 takes 95 s. I did not time the original at 5120 or 20480.\n\n**What changed**\n- `roomsim/roomsim.cpp` is the only source file, compiled as CUDA via `set_source_files_properties(... LANGUAGE CUDA)`. The sequential CPU paths are removed, so the CUDA path is the only path.\n- Form factors: the host generates the single mt19937 stream in the original (i, j) order and skips culled pairs, so RNG consumption is unchanged. The GPU evaluates one thread per pair. Host generation of the next chunk overlaps with GPU work on the current one (double-buffered, pinned memory).\n- Octree: flattened into a device array and traversed with a per-thread stack.
